questions.question: 1. An encoder–decoder Transformer translates a 6-token source to a 5-token target. Consider the two attention sub-layers of one decoder block while computing representation of target position 3. Which option correctly states source of Q, K, V and visible key positions?
options: Masked self-attention: Q from the decoder, K, V from the encoder output; 3 visible positions. Cross-attention: Q, K, V all from the encoder; 6 visible positions.

Masked self-attention: Q, K, V all from the decoder; 5 visible positions, since teacher forcing makes the whole target available. Cross-attention: Q from the encoder, K, V from the decoder; 6 visible positions.
Masked self-attention: Q, K, V all from the decoder; 3 visible positions. Cross-attention: Q from the decoder, K, V from the output of the top encoder block; 6 visible positions.

Masked self-attention: Q, K, V all from the decoder; 3 visible positions. Cross-attention: Q from the decoder, K, V from the top encoder block; 3 visible positions, because the same causal mask is applied there as well.
questions.correctAnswer: Masked self-attention: Q, K, V all from the decoder; 3 visible positions. Cross-attention: Q from the decoder, K, V from the output of the top encoder block; 6 visible positions.
questions.explanation: Masked self-attention operates within the target sequence with causal mask hiding positions 4 and 5 (so 3 visible keys: 1, 2, 3). Cross-attention uses Q from the decoder and K, V from the full top encoder block (all 6 source positions visible).

questions.question: 2. A single-head encoder self-attention layer has dmodel = 3 and dk = dv = 2. Token embeddings are x1 = [1, 0, 1], x2 = [0, 1, 2]. Projections are WQ = [[1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 0]], WK = [[1, 1], [0, -1], [0, 1]], WV = [[2, 0], [0, 1], [0, 1]]. Scores scaled by √dk. With e^1.414 ≈ 4.113, e^0 = 1, what is the self-attention output a1 for token 1?

3. Two multi-head attention layers have dmodel = 96. Config A: h = 6, dq = dk = dv = 16. Config B: h = 12, dq = dk = dv = 8. Ignoring biases, what is the total number of parameters in WQ, WK, WV and WO for A and B respectively?
questions.explanation: In both configurations h × dk = 96 = dmodel. Projections cost 3 × dmodel × (h × dk) = 3 × 96 × 96 = 27,648. Output projection WO costs 96 × 96 = 9,216. Total for each = 36,864.

questions.question: 4. A sparse mixture-of-experts layer contains E = 8 experts and routes each token independently with top-k routing, k = 2. A sequence of 6 tokens passes through the layer. How many token–expert feed-forward computations are performed, how many for Switch layer, and what fraction of all possible pairs is evaluated in the first case?
questions.explanation: With k = 2: 6 × 2 = 12 computations. Switch layer has k = 1: 6 × 1 = 6 computations. Total possible pairs = 6 × 8 = 48, so 12 / 48 = 25%.

questions.question: 5. In one attention head a query has dot products 2, 0 and −2 with the three keys of the sequence, and dk = 4. What is the attention distribution over the three keys?

6. A sequence of N = 4096 tokens is processed by a Linformer-style layer, which replaces the N × N attention-score matrix with an N × k matrix, k = 128. How many entries does each matrix contain, by what factor does the number of score entries fall, and is a 20× reduction achieved?
options: 16,777,216 and 524,288; a 16× reduction; the target is not met.
8,388,608 and 524,288; a 16× reduction; the target is not met.
16,777,216 and 16,384; a 1024× reduction; the target is met.
16,777,216 and 524,288; a 32× reduction; the target is met.
questions.correctAnswer: 16,777,216 and 524,288; a 32× reduction; the target is met.

questions.question: 7. A sparse mixture-of-experts layer has N = 4 experts with router logits (1, 2, 0, −1). Softmax gate values p = [0.237, 0.644, 0.087, 0.032], k = 2. Expert outputs: E1 = [1, 0], E2 = [0, 2], E3 = [2, 2], E4 = [-1, 1]. What are y and the output a Switch layer would produce?

8. A decoder self-attention layer processes a sequence of 7 tokens; entry (i, j) of the 7 × 7 score matrix is masked whenever j > i. How many entries survive the mask, and what fraction of the corresponding encoder count is that?
questions.explanation: Sum for i=1 to 7 is 7 × 8 / 2 = 28 entries. Encoder computes 7² = 49 entries. Fraction = 28 / 49 = 4/7 ≈ 0.571.
